scope: Explicit selected old/new pairs, three measured batches; not ABBA, statistical confidence or full CONTRIBUTING qualification

selected_blocks.boot_scope: Same uninterrupted recorded coordinator/lock and original run; explicit perhold bootUUID was not captured by historical runner. No closing quartet or crossing reboot is inferred.

token_hash_scope: Full server-reported token hashes; independently rebuilt content/reasoning fingerprint; no pertoken output ID arrays available
metric_scope: Server prefill elapsed excludes initial queue but includes scheduler elapsed time, not pureGPUcompute. Client TTFT is first nonempty text arrival; delivery TPOT and server mean decode interval are averages, not per-token ITL distributions. Chunk gaps are transport chunk gaps. Rate and latency change percentages retain their own denominators; no acceptance threshold.
